constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen

sentences.ar: والامتداد أو الـextension ده مجرد تلميح مش ضمانة أكيدة
sentences.en: And the extension is just a hint, not a sure guarantee.

sentences.ar: القسم الرابع Terminal والأوامر الأساسية
sentences.en: Section four: the terminal and basic commands.

sentences.ar: تخيلوا معي كده Terminal وهو بيتكتب حرف حرف ولوحة حالة الجهاز أو الـstate بتتغير جنبه في نفس اللحظة
sentences.en: Picture the terminal being typed letter by letter, with the machine's state panel changing beside it at the same moment.

sentences.ar: بنبدأ بـpwd اللي بيطبع إحنا فين بالظبط
sentences.en: We start with pwd, which prints exactly where we are.

sentences.ar: بعدين cd data بينقلنا الفولدر جديد وكأننا بنتحرك فعلياً جوه المكنة
sentences.en: Then cd data moves us to a new folder, as if we were physically moving inside the machine.

sentences.ar: وأخيراً ls -la بيعرض لنا كل الملفات اللي حوالينا حتى المخفية بكل تفاصيلها
sentences.en: Finally, ls -la shows all the files around us, even the hidden ones, with all their details.

sentences.ar: القسم الخامس الـpipes والـredirection
sentences.en: Section five: pipes and redirection.

sentences.ar: تخيلوا معايا علامة الـpipe دي كأنها أنابيب داتا حقيقية بتجري فيها المعلومات بسلاسة
sentences.en: Picture this pipe symbol as real data pipes with information flowing smoothly through them.

sentences.ar: الداتا بتطلع كـstdout من برنامج cat وتمشي جوه الأنبوبة دي عشان تدخل كـstdin لبرنامج grep اللي بيفلتر الكلمات الفاشلة
sentences.en: Data comes out as stdout from the cat program and travels through this pipe to enter as stdin to grep, which filters the failed words,

sentences.ar: وبعدين تكمل جريف أنبوبة تانية للـwc عشان يعد السطور
sentences.en: then continues through another pipe to wc to count the lines.

sentences.ar: وعشان نتحكم في الداتا اللي بتجري دي عندنا أدوات shell في منتهى الأهمية
sentences.en: To control this flowing data, we have extremely important shell tools.

sentences.ar: الـredirection بيخلينا نتحكم الـoutput يروح فين
sentences.en: Redirection lets us control where the output goes.

sentences.ar: علامة أكبر من بتكتب فوق الملف من الأول وعلامتين أكبر من أكبر من بيزودوا الداتا على آخر الملف
sentences.en: One greater-than sign overwrites the file from the start, and two greater-than signs append data to the end of the file.

sentences.ar: ولو طلع لنا أخطاء وعايزين نرميها عشان ننظف الشاشة بنستخدم 2 أكبر من slash dev slash null
sentences.en: And if we get errors we want to throw away to clean up the screen, we use 2>/dev/null.

sentences.ar: وطبعاً ما ننسيش إن الـshell بيعتمد على متغير خطير اسمه PATH
sentences.en: And of course, don't forget the shell relies on a critical variable called PATH,

sentences.ar: وده اللي بيعرف النظام الأوامر مستخبية في أي فولدرات
sentences.en: which tells the system which folders the commands are hidden in.

sentences.ar: وأكيد أمر history بينقذنا وبيحفظ كل اللي كتبناه عشان ما فيش داعي نعيد الكتابة من الصفر
sentences.en: And the history command saves us by keeping everything we typed, so there's no need to retype from scratch.

sentences.ar: القسم السادس والأخير حل المشاكل وتجهيز بيئة العمل
sentences.en: Section six, the last: troubleshooting and preparing the work environment.

sentences.ar: دلوقتي وقت العمل وحل المشاكل
sentences.en: Now it's time for work and troubleshooting.

sentences.ar: كتير بنشوف رسالة الخطأ الكلاسيكية دي وساعتها بنحس إن الدنيا وقفت
sentences.en: We often see this classic error message and feel like the world has stopped.

sentences.ar: وهنا بيجي دور أمر pwd كحل سحري وأداة التشخيص الأولى بتاعتنا
sentences.en: This is where the pwd command comes in, as a magic fix and our first diagnostic tool.

sentences.ar: في ثانية واحدة الأمر ده بيكشف لنا إحنا فين وبيوضح فوراً ليه الأمر اللي فات ملقاش الملف
sentences.en: In one second this command reveals where we are and immediately shows why the previous command didn't find the file.

sentences.ar: القاعدة الذهبية هنا نقرأ رسالة الخطأ نختبر مكاننا ونفهم إحنا فين قبل ما نجري ندور على النت
sentences.en: The golden rule: read the error message, check where we are and understand it, before rushing to search the internet.

sentences.ar: وقبل ما نتعمق أكتر لازم نتأكد أن العدة بتاعتنا جاهزة ومتجربة
sentences.en: And before going deeper, we must make sure our toolkit is ready and tested.

sentences.ar: أدوات زي VS Code Python Git PostgreSQL وDocker مش كفاية أننا نسطبهم وبس
sentences.en: For tools like VS Code, Python, Git, PostgreSQL and Docker, just installing them isn't enough.

sentences.ar: لازم نستخدم أوامر زي --version عشان نتأكد أن كل أداة شغالة تمام
sentences.en: We must use commands like --version to make sure each tool works properly.

sentences.ar: الخطوة دي أساسية جداً قبل ما نرفع أول commit في الـrepository بتاع ShopFlow
sentences.en: This step is essential before we push the first commit to the ShopFlow repository.

sentences.ar: وبكده نوصل لآخر نقطة في الشرح ده
sentences.en: And with that we reach the last point of this explainer.

sentences.ar: هل نقدر بعد ما فهمنا الأساسيات دي أننا نحلل أي رسالة خطأ تقابلنا ونفهم منطق الـterminal بدل ما ننسخها ونرميها على الانترنت وخلاص
sentences.en: Having understood these basics, can we analyze any error message we meet and understand the terminal's logic, instead of just copying it and throwing it at the internet?

sentences.ar: الثقة اللي بتتبني من فهم الأساسيات دي هي اللي هتخلينا متحكمين بجد في المكنة
sentences.en: The confidence built from understanding these basics is what will truly put us in control of the machine.

sentences.ar: الأساس اللي بنينا النهاردة هيخلي كل اللي جاي أسهل بكتير
sentences.en: The foundation we built today will make everything ahead much easier.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: Sending a command's output to a file, or reading input from one, with >, >> and <, instead of using the screen.
concepts.def_ar: توجيه output الأمر لملف بدل الشاشة، أو قراءة input من ملف، باستخدام > و>> و<.
concepts.failure: Using > instead of >>, which overwrites the whole file instead of appending.

concepts.def_en: Operator | that connects one command's output directly to the next command's input, so small tools combine into a pipeline.
concepts.def_ar: علامة | بتوصّل output أمر مباشرة بـinput الأمر اللي بعده، فالأدوات الصغيرة تتركّب مع بعض.
concepts.failure: Expecting stderr to flow through a pipe; only stdout is piped unless redirected.

concepts.def_en: A command-line program, such as bash, that reads typed commands, runs them and prints the results.
concepts.def_ar: برنامج command-line زي الـbash، بيستقبل الأوامر اللي بتكتبها وينفّذها ويطبعلك النتيجة.
concepts.failure: Running commands blindly from the wrong working directory.

concepts.def_en: A marker meaning a value is missing or unknown, not zero or an empty string; comparing with it is never simply true or false.
concepts.def_ar: الـnull معناها إن القيمة مش موجودة أو مجهولة، مش صفر ولا نص فاضي، وأي مقارنة بيها مش بتدّي true ولا false.
concepts.failure: Using = NULL instead of IS NULL, so rows with missing values silently disappear.

concepts.def_en: Environment variable listing the folders the shell searches, in order, to find the progra…
concepts.failure: Getting 'command not found' because the program's folder isn't listed in PATH.

concepts.def_en: A message or failure signalling that something went wrong; read it first, since it usuall…
concepts.failure: Pasting the error into a search engine without first reading the terminal output.

concepts.def_en: A readable, general-purpose programming language widely used for data analysis, automatio…
concepts.failure: Using plain loops over huge data instead of vectorized pandas or SQL operations.

concepts.def_en: A distributed version-control system that records snapshots (commits) of a project, enabling history, branches and merging of work.
concepts.def_ar: نظام version control موزّع بيسجّل snapshots (commits) للمشروع، وبيوفر التاريخ والـbranches ودمج الشغل.
concepts.failure: Confusing Git with GitHub; Git is the local tool, GitHub is one hosting service.

concepts.def_en: An open-source relational database (SQL) system known for standards compliance, transacti…
concepts.failure: Assuming it behaves exactly like MySQL; syntax, types and plans differ between them.

concepts.def_en: A tool that packages an app with everything it needs into a container, so it runs the sam…
concepts.failure: Expecting data inside a container to persist after the container is removed.

concepts.def_en: In git, a saved snapshot of changes with a message; in databases, the step that makes a transaction permanent.
concepts.def_ar: في git: لقطة محفوظة من التغييرات ومعاها رسالة؛ وفي الـdatabases: الخطوة اللي بتثبّت الـtransaction نهائيًا.
concepts.failure: Committing unrelated changes together with vague messages, making review and rollback hard.

concepts.def_en: In Git, a project with its full version history that others can clone. In design, a class hiding how data is stored.
concepts.def_ar: في Git، الـrepository هو المشروع بتاريخ نسخه كامل وغيرك يقدر يعمله clone. وفي الـdesign، class بتخفي طريقة تخزين الداتا.
concepts.failure: Committing secrets, large data or generated files into the repository.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A tree as a flat parent list: variant btree | plan | decision | fs.
A terminal (LTR isolate) whose lines appear on anchors.
